title: Kathleen HERTZ iMessage invitation — interview at Hertz Ridder Park, 725 Ridder Park Dr., San Jose. Message says 'Thursday 10/21 at 1pm' — weekday/date conflict retained; exact meeting date is not resolved.
Applicant iMessage to Kathleen: almost there; rain and traffic delayed arrival. No employment decision at this point.
Gloria Williams, Hertz Talent Acquisition Partner, emailed that the team wanted to extend a Manager Trainee offer for Palo Alto.
Hertz Careers emailed formal notification that the Manager Trainee offer was extended.
Kathleen HERTZ iMessage: applicant should receive an offer for Manager Trainee at Palo Alto; recruiter response at later time confirms 'You're welcome.'
Applicant emailed Gloria Williams expressing acceptance of the Manager Trainee opportunity.
Hertz Careers emailed confirmation: 'you just accepted the job offer Manager Trainee.' Portal separately shows Offer Accepted.
ADP sent Work Opportunity Tax Credit questionnaire request referring to Hertz Global Holdings, Inc. Distinct from HireRight employment background screening.
Hertz Careers requested additional information for the Manager Trainee application. Completion not yet confirmed.
ADP WOTC confirmation screenshot captured at 5:44 p.m.; tax-credit questionnaire completed. No background-check conclusion shown.
Gloria Williams sent pre-boarding instructions identifying an Oracle information task and an immediate HireRight background request.
HireRight invited applicant to begin The Hertz Corporation background verification and stated consent was required before processing.
Applicant electronically signed HireRight's standalone background disclosure and authorization. The source form uses the candidate name Brendan Ngehsi Ngwanforbi.

Applicant signed HireRight acknowledgments and investigative-report disclosures, checked the California free-report-copy election, and submitted the screening information. HireRight confirmed processing had begun.

HireRight notified applicant that an MVR Express report containing public-record information had been furnished to Gloria Williams at The Hertz Corporation. Underlying MVR contents were not included in the supplied PDF.

HireRight completed order OR-102326-NH87V for Hertz pre-employment and emailed the applicant a copy of the report. Adjudication printed as Client Review Required. The email says Hertz has not made a final decision.
HireRight activity log: applicant opened the background report at 6:16 a.m. Pacific. The log also shows earlier opens on Oct. 27, Oct. 29, and Oct. 31.

HireRight emailed the applicant an urgent notice that The Hertz Corporation had background-check information, and listed a California pre-adverse letter and an FCRA summary. The letter specifies alcohol-related information, says any decision is preliminary, and does not fill in a calendar deadline.
